slides.texte_overlay:
odd little habits that make
everyone want to talk to you

using names

use people's names once or twice in a conversation. hearing their own name makes people feel noticed, and they quietly remember who made them feel that way.

laughing easily

laugh at other people's jokes, even the small ones. people love being around someone who makes them feel funny, and a warm laugh is wonderfully contagious.

remembering details

remember one small thing someone told you and ask about it next time: a trip, an exam, a dog. it shows you truly listen, and that is rare enough to be magnetic.

sharing odd facts

spend 5 minutes a day learning one odd fact: how bees dance, why the sky is blue. people always drift towards the person with something surprising to share.

slides.texte_overlay:
putting the phone away

keep your phone in your bag when you're with people. full attention has become so rare that people instantly feel how different it is to talk with you.
